verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only a generic mention of 'member-level rates' for registration and auto-renewal (godaddy-docs-3/26) with no actual published per-TLD price table separating registration, renewal, and transfer costs, and no confirmation that first-year pricing isn't a teaser. Community reports (godaddy-comm-5, godaddy-comm-9, godaddy-comm-10) describe rising renewal prices and hidden upsells rather than transparent published pricing, reinforcing the absence of this capability rather than disputing an explicit vendor claim.
